  CAST(substr(re.time,1,instr(re.time,':')-1) AS REAL)*3600 +

  CAST(substr(re.time,instr(re.time,':')+4) AS REAL)
) AS avg_seconds
FROM results re
JOIN races ra ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE re.position = 1 AND re.time LIKE '%:%:%' AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY ra.year
ORDER BY ra.year
